dataProvenance: Same local reconstruction as m0-m2.json. Milestone 3 (ResultsAgent) is implemented and unit/integration-tested with mocked Perplexity/OpenAI responses, but this sandbox has no production DATABASE_URL or AI API keys (standing constraint, disclosed since Milestone 1's real-world-accuracy-audit request), so ResultsAgent has never been run against real Perplexity data for any golden athlete. This snapshot is therefore identical to m2.json by construction, not evidence of no improvement -- see the M3 status note in task-27-implementation-roadmap.md and the Actual outcome note in task-27-success-metrics.md for the full explanation, including a separately-disclosed gap: the IQS formula itself (iqs.ts, built in Milestone 0) does not currently score confidence/evidence-validity from athletes' scalar stat columns at all -- only pbSbConsistency reads them -- so even a live ResultsAgent run would not move this score today.
todoBeforeProductionRelease: Regenerate this snapshot by running scripts/audit-iqs.ts against the live production database before the platform's first production release. Every number in this file is a development baseline, not a claim about production data quality.
